title: pandanus tectorius var. laevis
intro: Pandanus tectorius var. laevis, commonly known as the screw pine, is a type of plant native to the Pacific Islands, characterized by its distinctive, spiraling trunk and edible fruit. The plant is used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and the relief of symptoms associated with various gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of Pandanus tectorius var. laevis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of the plant work synergistically to provide its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
